verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents a smart-linking feature that ties cap table entries to supporting documents, explicitly including stock certificates tied to the award agreement, board consent and exercise actions. It also documents in-platform e-signing of workflow documents (draw, upload or type a signature, with emailed signing links). However, no evidence explicitly describes a workflow for issuing electronic share certificates or confirms that certificates are signed in-platform; the certificate capability is only implied by the linkage claim. Missing for 10: an explicit documented e-certificate issuance workflow, confirmation that certificates themselves are legally signed in-platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
